releaseTitle: Hotspot Manager v1.6.1 - CPU Spike Fix & UI Polish
releaseNotes:
• Router CPU Spike Fix (KyawGyi): Throttled heavy hotspot user database queries to 60s (previously dumping thousands of vouchers every poll cycle and driving CPU to 89%+). Throttled clock queries to 3m and active sessions loop to 8s.
• Header Cleanup: Removed settings cog and update buttons from the top bar for a minimalist, uncluttered dashboard.
• Printer in Settings: Thermal Bluetooth printer management relocated directly into the Settings tab.
• Navigation Bar & Layout Fix: Eliminated double-insets causing blank white padding at the bottom of screens, restored space for content, and added a sleek rounded frosted glass bottom navigation bar.
• PPPoE Smart Visibility: PPPoE tab is automatically hidden for routers without PPPoE configuration.
